title: Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Dimerization-Coupled Fold Switching in the Chemokine XCL1.
authors: Seifi, Bahman; de Souza, Greg; Wallin, Stefan
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化结构模型研究XCL1蛋白二聚化耦合的折叠转换热力学与动力学，属于蛋白质构象采样与结构计算问题，方法为物理模拟，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Metamorphic proteins challenge the classical view of protein folding by reversibly interconverting between two distinct, stable native structures. XCL1 (lymphotactin) is a prototypical example, transitioning between a monomeric mixed- alpha/beta chemokine fold and an alternate all- beta fold that forms a stable dimer. Here we develop and apply a coarse-grained, structure-based model to investigate how temperature and electrostatic screening control this fold switch. By tuning the relative interaction strength of native contacts in the two folds, we show that the model qualitatively reproduces the experimentally observed temperature dependence of XCL1 fold populations, including an increasing alternate-fold population with increasing temperature. We introduce a sequence-dependent treatment of salt effects, which reveals a strong sensitivity of the fold equilibrium to salt concentration and yields a temperature-salt phase diagram with a broad coexistence region. Focusing on conditions near coexistence, kinetic simulations of the chemokine-to-alternate fold transition show that productive dimerization tends to occur when both chains are at least partially unfolded, and that formation of the final alternate dimer may proceed via an intermediate state characterized by a partially formed dimer interface. Finally, we use the model to examine how charge patterning in ancestral variants of XCL1 modulates the population balance between the two folds.
abstract_zh: 变形蛋白通过两种不同且稳定的天然结构之间的可逆互变，挑战了蛋白质折叠的经典观点。XCL1（淋巴细胞趋化因子）是一个典型例子，它在单体混合α/β趋化因子折叠与形成稳定二聚体的替代全β折叠之间转换。在此，我们开发并应用一种粗粒化、基于结构的模型，以研究温度和静电屏蔽如何控制这一折叠开关。通过调节两种折叠中天然接触的相对相互作用强度，我们表明该模型定性地重现了实验观察到的XCL1折叠群体随温度的变化，包括随温度升高替代折叠群体增加的现象。我们引入了一种序列依赖的盐效应处理方法，揭示了折叠平衡对盐浓度的强烈敏感性，并生成了一个具有宽共存区域的温度-盐相图。聚焦于接近共存的条件，趋化因子到替代折叠转变的动力学模拟显示，当两条链至少部分解折叠时，生产性二聚化往往发生，且最终替代二聚体的形成可能通过一个以部分形成二聚体界面为特征的中间状态进行。最后，我们利用该模型检验XCL1祖先变体中电荷模式如何调节两种折叠之间的群体平衡。
